caption: The drawing depicts a large, round, brownish stoneware jug with a cylindrical neck, a curved handle attached to the neck and shoulder, and a spout extending upward at an angle from the upper right side. The jug is decorated with blue floral patterns and calligraphic text across its upper surface and body, some of which includes a date, “1798.” The flowers have circular centers and are surrounded by blue leaves and stems. The text and designs are rendered in a rich cobalt blue that stands out against the tan-brown color of the jug. The jug sits on a small circular base, and there are concentric horizontal lines incised around the neck. The background is plain and off-white, which contrasts with the jug and emphasizes its form and ornamentation.
title: Water Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
